observed_behavior: A successful native inspection-only worker returned prose and submission collection failed at JSON parsing.
expected_behavior: Every successful obligation submits physical V1 JSON with actual candidate and proof, including an unchanged candidate.
causal_mechanism: The collector requires structured submissions for all successful workers, but the prompt explicitly required JSON only for code submissions. The no-edit path therefore followed its prose report instruction.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Producer instructions specialize a shared output protocol to a narrower execution class than the consumer accepts.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: An otherwise successful producer emits an incompatible representation at the shared handoff.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Successful producer output conforms to the consumer protocol across every supported obligation class.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: The shared worker instructions require the existing exact V1 JSON for every successful obligation; inspection reports are retained evidence rather than the final wire message.

applicability_conditions: The same collector handles changed and unchanged candidates.
An agent-facing prompt determines the producer output representation.
known_non_matches: Code-changing workers were already explicitly instructed to submit JSON.
confirmation_evidence: The real native no-edit Arc failed with JSON value expected at the collector before the prompt correction.
The same Arc passed after the prompt correction, preserving unchanged HEAD, durable REVIEW and idempotent replay.
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-codex.integration.ts: live no-edit worker submits actual inspection proof and reaches review without a code commit
